response.sql: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, line_count, 1.0 * line_count / SUM(line_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(ps.line_count) AS combined_count, AVG(ps.share) AS average_share, AVG(ps.share - oa.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_shares AS ps CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE ps.share > oa.average_share
